title: BEACON D6-2 Relief supply — new aggregate-only fields
description: The NEW optional fields FR-D6-2 (ADR-035 §4) adds to a Resource of kind 'SUPPLY' — a supply lot is stock, counted and located as a LOT, never attributed to the person who gave it (Art. XIV; ADR-035 §4 hard boundary: 'no person-identifying field may exist on any D6 entity'). Scoped to ONLY the new fields, not the whole Resource entity ('SUPPLY' already exists in RESOURCE_KINDS at src/domain/resource.ts:9; id/status/orgId/geom are unchanged by this schema). PERMANENTLY OUT, restated here so it cannot creep back as a 'small addition': no donor field and no payment field, ever (ADR-035 §4 PERMANENTLY-OUT; CURRENT-MASTER-PLAN.md:123-124 'NO payments ever') — 'donor', 'donorId', 'payment', 'amount', 'cardNumber', 'iban' and 'account' are all in PERSON_IDENTIFYING_KEYS (src/domain/shared/aggregate-only.ts), so adding any of them fails Layer A (tsc), Layer B (this file's walk) and Layer C (runtime) at once. Layer B walks this file automatically via tests/architecture/d6-no-pii.test.ts's schemas/d6-*.schema.json glob — no change to the guard was needed to pick it up.

kind.description: The Resource.kind discriminator this fields object extends. Already present in RESOURCE_KINDS — FR-D6-2 adds no kind, only the three optional fields below.

quantity.description: An AGGREGATE stock count of the lot, in `unit`. Deliberately named `quantity`, NOT `amount`: 'amount' is in PERSON_IDENTIFYING_KEYS because it is the field a donation/payment record would use, and the D6 boundary must not carry one (ADR-035 §4). An integer, never a currency value — there is no currency field anywhere in D6.

unit.description: The unit `quantity` is counted in. A closed enum rather than free text so a quantity is always comparable across lots and no free-text field is introduced on this entity.

expiresAt.description: ISO-8601 UTC expiry of the lot (consumables/medication stock). A property of the STOCK, not of any person — no patient, no prescription, no recipient is modelled or retained.
